Using the Fetch API

By default, fetch makes a GET request, but you can use the method option to use a different request method. The following example sends a POST request. The example is rendered inside an open shadow root on the source page.

If the mode option is set to no-cors, then method must be one of GET, POST or HEAD. Use the response to inspect the result of the request. The inline expression fetch(url) is separate from the example.
